title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: Experience the full power of Spyglass, now officially launched to provide you with comprehensive new insights.

title: Enhanced File Management in Editor
summary: Users can now effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the display of their embedded files directly within the editor for a more powerful and tailored content creation experience.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap, your go-to destination to explore recently shipped features, upcoming enhancements, and our exciting vision for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved checkbox experience with bigger, easier-to-click, and draggable checkboxes, designed to streamline your workflows.

title: Enhanced Editor Collaboration
summary: Experience a significantly smoother and more intuitive way to collaborate with others in the editor, making teamwork more efficient and enjoyable.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Discovery
summary: We've made it easier to find and work together on shared items, ensuring seamless collaboration and discovery of important ideas.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce that Noeko's entire codebase is now open source, offering you unparalleled transparency and the direct opportunity to contribute to its future development.

title: Speak Your Language
summary: We're expanding Noeko to support multiple international languages, allowing more users worldwide to experience our platform in their native tongue.

title: Expanded & Refined Theme Gallery
summary: We are introducing a diverse collection of new themes alongside significant improvements to existing ones, offering you more ways to personalize your application's appearance with style and clarity.

title: Smarter Constellation View for Effortless Exploration
summary: We're transforming your Constellation view into a dynamic exploration hub with powerful new filtering by tags and time, alongside seamless sharing options, to help you effortlessly navigate and organize your entire knowledge base.

title: Refined Search & Custom Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base by applying powerful filters and saving curated collections for effortless retrieval.

title: Dynamic Content Views for Streamlined Note-Taking
summary: Discover new dynamic display modes for linked content that empower you to seamlessly organize and visualize your thoughts within your notes.

title: Noeko's Official Launch: Self-Hosted and Flexible Plans
summary: We're thrilled to officially launch Noeko, offering both a free self-hosted community edition and flexible premium plans to empower every team with enhanced control and scalability.

title: More Accurate Daily Greetings
summary: We're updating our greetings to always match the precise time of day, ensuring a perfectly tailored welcome whenever you use the app.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new direct actions that allow you to remove items and perform other essential operations right from your tag lists.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a richer variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to power your insights and knowledge.
